title: Elodie and the Alibi
author: Noor Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
